questions.stemHtml: 45 year old alcoholic patient presented with one week H/O diarrhoea, fever, nausea and right upper abdominal pain. USG revealed a 75 cc liver abscess. Stool examination shown below. Which of the following statement is false about this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Associate with golf hole shaped ulcers in ileocecal area.

options.label: B
options.text: Right lobe abscess, situated on superior surface may cause pain in right shoulder.

options.label: C
options.text: Abscess at bare area of liver may be painless.

options.label: D
options.text: Abscess situated in the left lobe is an indication for drainage
